clue.text: Inform Dame Nellie that dessert is served

parts.note: to peach is old slang for informing on someone, grassing
Dame Nellie Melba was the famous Australian soprano

explanation.surface: An announcement that a pudding has been brought to a famous opera singer's table.
explanation.walkthrough: The dessert was in fact created in honour of Dame Nellie Melba, so the surface story is half true.
explanation.definitionFit: A classic pudding of poached peaches, vanilla ice cream and raspberry sauce.

clue.text: Key study by a former prime minister

parts.note: E is a musical key
a den is a private room for study or work

explanation.surface: A piece of music practised in the company of an ex-premier.
explanation.walkthrough: Anthony Eden was British Prime Minister 1955-57.
explanation.definitionFit: Anthony Eden held Britain's top political office in the mid-1950s.

clue.text: The islander is in a kind of trance

indicators.note: a kind of signals the word trance remade into a different form

explanation.surface: A man from some island has fallen into a hypnotic state.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Crete, the largest Greek island.

clue.text: He got old, but coped

parts.note: he refers to a male person, a man
aged means grew older

explanation.surface: An old man who managed all the same despite his years.
explanation.definitionFit: To have managed is to have got by or handled a situation.

clue.text: Nothing is the same as a deep romantic attachment

definitions.meaning: a score of zero in tennis
the strong affection felt between partners

explanation.surface: A cynic's claim that passion amounts to nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Zero in tennis scoring; also passionate affection for another person.

clue.text: Wasting a prize asset

parts.note: a trophy is a prized possession won in competition

explanation.surface: Someone frittering away a valuable possession they won.
explanation.definitionFit: A noun for the withering away of muscle or tissue through disuse.

clue.text: Going to the Commons? No, stuck at home

parts.note: the House of Commons, the British lower chamber, is called the House
bound for a place means heading to it

explanation.surface: Asked if they are heading off to Parliament, an MP says no, they are confined indoors.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'No' corrects the surface suggestion of a trip to Westminster; it is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone unable to leave their dwelling through illness or age.

clue.text: Established head of department supports the academy

indicators.note: in a down answer a piece that supports another sits beneath it

parts.note: an institute is a learned body like an academy

indicators.note: head of means the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A new head of department now backing the college has been set up.
explanation.definitionFit: Set up or founded, as an organisation or procedure.

clue.text: Fool — I don't believe it!

definitions.meaning: a silly person
... as an exclamation of disbelief

explanation.surface: A reaction to a ridiculous claim: you idiot, that cannot be true.
explanation.definitionFit: A clownish idiot; also the phrase said in disbelief, split into two words.

clue.text: Repeated refusal to give credit

indicators.note: repeated means the word is said twice in a row

parts.note: never is an emphatic refusal

explanation.surface: A lender saying no again and again to a borrower.
explanation.walkthrough: THE NEVER-NEVER is British slang for hire purchase, buying on instalments.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang for buying on hire purchase, paying in instalments.

clue.text: An unfashionable group from the very beginning

parts.note: out means no longer in vogue
a set is a group of people or things

explanation.surface: A dowdy clique that has existed since day one.
explanation.definitionFit: The start or opening of something.

clue.text: Fail to be an author

definitions.meaning: to collapse or sink, as a business or ship does
the originator who sets something up

explanation.surface: A writer's fear of failing.
explanation.definitionFit: To sink or collapse; also one who establishes an institution.

clue.text: Disregarding the purpose of an acquisitive society

definitions.meaning: leaving out of mind, neglecting

definitions.text: the purpose of an acquisitive society
definitions.meaning: a grasping society exists ..., split into two words

explanation.surface: A remark that a greedy society ignores higher aims.
explanation.definitionFit: Overlooking or failing to recall; also read as two words, the aim of acquiring.

clue.text: Where to find a koala in difficulties

definitions.meaning: a koala lives in a eucalyptus, a gum tree
in a predicament, stuck

explanation.surface: A koala in a tight spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally aloft in a eucalyptus; idiomatically, stuck in trouble.

clue.text: Light material

parts.note: reads as a lightweight fabric but punningly as a beam of light, the first part

explanation.definitionFit: A synthetic fabric made from cellulose, typically light in weight.

clue.text: Ready to include aromatic flavouring in a drink

indicators.note: to include means one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: set means prepared, ready
a herb is an aromatic plant used for flavour

explanation.surface: A drink, prepared and spiced with something fragrant.
explanation.definitionFit: A fizzy or fruit-flavoured beverage, as in the Middle East.

clue.text: Heavy fall in demand for casual builders after September

indicators.note: after means this piece comes later than the September piece

parts.note: S is a short form of September
the lump is British slang for self-employed casual building labour

explanation.surface: Fewer odd-job builders wanted once autumn arrives.
explanation.walkthrough: THE LUMP is British slang for casual, self-employed workers in the building trade.
explanation.definitionFit: An economic downturn, a sharp drop in trade.

clue.text: Daughter and friend make trifle

parts.note: an ally is a friend

explanation.surface: A girl and her pal preparing a pudding together.
explanation.definitionFit: Trifle as a verb, to play about and waste time.

clue.text: Genuine old Spanish coin

definitions.meaning: ... means authentic
a former silver coin of Spain

explanation.surface: An authentic antique piece of Spanish currency.
explanation.definitionFit: Authentic; also a former Spanish silver coin.

clue.text: It's only fair

definitions.meaning: ... meaning merely
... meaning equitable

explanation.surface: A remark that something is merely what is deserved.
explanation.definitionFit: Merely, as an adverb; and equitable, as an adjective.

clue.text: Follow mother in principle

parts.note: to dog someone is to follow them closely
ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: A child copying Mum on a matter of principle.
explanation.definitionFit: A fixed belief or tenet held as unquestionable.

clue.text: The non-drinker in action is making little mark

indicators.note: in means the non-drinker piece goes inside the action piece

parts.note: doing means activity, action
TT means teetotal, a non-drinker

explanation.surface: A sober person at work makes no great impression.
explanation.definitionFit: Putting small dots, marking with tiny points.

clue.text: Alfred twice writes an article on Lucerne

indicators.note: twice means the short name is written two times

parts.note: Alf is a short form of Alfred
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A man named Alfred writing an essay about a Swiss city.
explanation.walkthrough: Lucerne looks like the Swiss city, but here it is the fodder plant, also called lucerne in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Another name for the same leguminous fodder crop.

clue.text: Outline needs revision because it's a washout

indicators.note: needs revision signals the word Outline rewritten in a new order

explanation.surface: A draft plan that must be redone because it is a failure.
explanation.definitionFit: In chemistry, the washing out of an adsorbed substance by a solvent.

clue.text: Begged to be represented in court

definitions.meaning: implored, entreated
argued a case before a judge

explanation.surface: A defendant who begged to have a lawyer.
explanation.definitionFit: Entreated earnestly; also argued a case as an advocate.

clue.text: Disinclined to write a poem

parts.note: a verse is a poem or piece of poetry

explanation.surface: Someone reluctant to compose poetry.
explanation.definitionFit: Opposed to or unwilling.

clue.text: Little bird with a little morsel of food

parts.note: a tit is a small songbird
a bit means a little

explanation.surface: A small bird carrying a tiny scrap to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: A tasty small piece, a tidbit in American use.

clue.text: Boss of a horse-breeding establishment

definitions.meaning: a raised knob or boss
a ... farm where horses are bred

explanation.surface: The owner of a stud farm.
explanation.definitionFit: A projecting ornamental knob; also a farm for breeding horses.

clue.text: One section of the military

definitions.meaning: a ... is a single thing, the number one
a military ..., such as a company

explanation.surface: A single detachment of the army.
explanation.definitionFit: The number one; also a detachment of troops.

clue.text: I learnt to become unsympathetic to others' opinions

indicators.note: become signals that the fodder letters change into a new word

parts.note: the fodder as printed is one N short of the answer's letters

explanation.surface: Someone who has learned to be narrow-minded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'become' is the anagram signal, but I LEARNT TO is one N short of the ten letters needed; the setter likely meant fodder such as 'I learnt not'.
explanation.definitionFit: Unwilling to accept views different from one's own.

clue.text: Want the north-eastern edition

explanation.surface: A request for the edition printed in the north-east.
explanation.definitionFit: To lack or require something.

clue.text: Sponsors who may be worshipped by their children

definitions.meaning: those who stand surety at a baptism

definitions.text: who may be worshipped by their children
definitions.meaning: parents treated as deities, read as two words

explanation.surface: Christening sponsors so revered that the children idolise them.
explanation.definitionFit: Baptismal sponsors; also, playfully, mothers and fathers adored like deities.
